lifecycle_dependency: Governance obligations must remain connected to identifiable lifecycle responsibilities and activities during platform evolution

contextual_basis: TAIOT-A01; TAIOT-A02; TAIOT-A03; TAIOT-A04; documented maintenance, change-management, update, and policy-adaptation evidence

target_lifecycle_location: Maintenance, change-management, platform-update, and policy-adaptation activities
process_specific_activity_or_control_poi: Maintenance procedures, change-management mechanisms, platform updates, responsibility mechanisms, and policy adaptation
